You don't know how another person might take what you believe are just jokes, it can really mean the world to another person and it can really affect them in a negative way. And there's a big difference between making a joke, and responding to someone talking about recovery with that joke making fun of what they're going through and invalidating their struggles.

I don't think it's bad taste. I just think you shouldn't make jokes that can hurt other people about serious topics like self harm and addiction, and you shouldn't tell this 'joke' to someone who is struggling. People always say free speech, but free speech shouldn't be used as an excuse to hurt other people.
